questions.question: Work out 1 248 plus 397 by breaking down and by rounding and compensating, and show that the two agree.
questions.expected_answer: Breaking down: 1 000 plus 300 is 1 300, 200 plus 90 is 290, 40 plus 7 is 47 and 8; or by like parts 1 000 plus 500 plus 130 plus 15 is 1 645. Compensating: 1 248 plus 400 is 1 648, minus 3 is 1 645. Both give 1 645.

questions.question: Work out 2 650 minus 1 875 by building up and by rounding and compensating, and explain the direction of the compensation.
questions.expected_answer: Building up: 1 875 plus 25 is 1 900, plus 100 is 2 000, plus 650 is 2 650, and 25 plus 100 plus 650 is 775. Compensating: 2 650 minus 1 900 is 750; 1 900 is 25 more than 1 875, so 25 too much was taken away and must be added back, giving 775.

questions.question: A savings jar grows from R1 395 to R2 000. Find the amount added and explain how inverse operations let you check it.
questions.expected_answer: The amount added is 2 000 minus 1 395, which is 605. Addition undoes subtraction, so 1 395 plus 605 should give 2 000; it does, so R605 is correct.
